scheme_name: Banglashree for Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises: Subsidy on Stamp Duty and Registration Fee (SDRFS)
other_conditions: The enterprise must belong to the manufacturing sector.
The business/organization should be in the private sector, cooperative sector, joint sector undertaking, or be a company/undertaking owned and managed by the State Government or Industrial SHGs.
Production must have started on or after 1 April 2019.
Date of Commencement of Commercial Production (DOCCP) must be between 1 April 2020 and 31 March 2025.
First application must be submitted within 12 months from the DOCCP or within 12 months from the date of notification of Banglashree, whichever is later.
benefits_summary: Provides a subsidy on stamp duty and registration fees for eligible MSMEs, with reimbursement rates ranging from 25% to 100% based on enterprise size and zone.
